title: Leg Massage — 20 Minutes
summary: A calm sequence of stroking and moderate kneading for the major leg muscles.
goal: Combine basic thigh and lower-leg techniques into a short routine.
startingPosition: The legs are fully supported and relaxed.
instructions: 4 min — calf stroking and gentle kneading.
direction: Upward over soft tissues while avoiding joints and the back of the knee.
warning: This educational routine is not treatment. Do not perform it with contraindications, acute pain, recent injury, inflammation, or worsening wellbeing.
